levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
يحيى بن يعلى بن حارث المحاربي

notes: Three Companions (جابر، ابن عمر، ابن عباس) are co-transmitters of the same saying at the last level, so they share one level; the Prophet is not a link.
«حدثنا أبي» is the teacher's father, named only by relation (rule 7). The comma in «ابن، عمر» is kept as written.
